title: Porsche: history, iconic cars, photos & films
description: Explore Porsche through original stories, 24 credited photographs, eight generations of the 911, official films and the complete MotorJury Porsche directory.
sources: Engineering office, 356 No. 1 and the rear-engined production 356.
Historical introductions and brand milestones; not a current product list.
901 debut, 1964 name change and rear-mounted flat-six.
Historical generation changes; introduction years can differ from model years.
1993 introduction and the end of air-cooled 911 production in 1998.
1997 introduction, parts sharing and the business and regulatory context.
992 premiere and continuity of the 911 concept.
1951 Le Mans class victory, 1970 overall victory and 1986 Dakar result.
1986 rally cars and the museum's conservation of their original wear.
1993 concept, August 1996 production and mid-engine layout.
2002 debut, commercial expansion and the SUV's engineering brief.
First electric production Porsche and its 800-volt architecture.
The engineering office and National Socialism
Porsche's account of research into its Nazi-era involvement and forced labour.
The Cayenne convertible that stayed a one-off
A full-size open-top design study, not a production model.
Archive research and Porsche's official film series; episode links checked on its verified channel.
